[{"word":"smart","pronun":"[smɑːrt]","translation":"adj. 聪明的；巧妙的；敏捷的；厉害的；潇洒的；剧烈的；时髦的","audio":"smart.mp3"},{"word":"smell","pronun":"[smel]","translation":"n. 气味，嗅觉；臭味
